body_markdown:
BOISE, Idaho – November 10, 2026 – Boise Cascade Company (“Boise Cascade” or the “Company”) (NYSE: BCC) today announced it has completed the transaction to acquire two building materials distribution facilities from Taiga Building Products in Rocklin and Sanger, California, as previously announced on November 5, 2026.


The acquisition expands Boise Cascade’s distribution presence in California and strengthens its ability to serve customers throughout the region. It also enhances the Company’s general line product capabilities and support the continued growth of its recently expanded partnership with James Hardie®.


“We are excited to officially welcome the Rocklin and Sanger locations to the Boise Cascade team,” said Jo Barney, Executive Vice President of Boise Cascade’s Building Materials Distribution division. “We appreciate everyone who helped make this transaction possible and look forward to the opportunities ahead.”


**Investor Contact:** Chris Forrey,[\[email protected\]](https://www.bc.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#a9c0c7dfccdaddc6dbe9cbca87cac6c4)
**Media Contact:** Amy Evans,[\[email protected\]](https://www.bc.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#a3cec6c7cac2d1c6cfc2d7cacccdd0e3c1c08dc0ccce)


**About Boise Cascade** Boise Cascade is one of the largest U.S. wholesale distributors of building materials and a leading manufacturer of engineered wood products and plywood in North America. Our integrated model and national distribution footprint position us to deliver outstanding service to our customers across a broad range of industry-leading products, including key structural products that we produce. Headquartered in Boise, Idaho, we operate more than 60 distribution and manufacturing facilities strategically located across the U.S. and Canada. Our work is powered by a dedicated team of over 7,500 people. For more information, visit:[Boise Cascade | Our Company](https://www.bc.com/company/)
